typography.lead: A case study covering requirements, hardware, software, and results, from the first sketch to a working prototype.
typography.p: The device measures blood oxygen saturation (SpO2) and pulse rate with a MAX30102 sensor. The circuit runs on a 3.7 V battery, draws less than 20 mA, and shows readings on a 128×64 OLED display.
typography.blockquote: A good medical device is one the patient trusts before the doctor does.

richText.heading: Results
richText.paragraph: Across 20 volunteers, readings stayed within 2% of the reference device at rest. Motion added more than 3% of noise, so the firmware now drops samples taken while the accelerometer reports movement.
